nodes.description: Address of the contract owner, set to tx.origin in the ApeHaven constructor; gates delegate() and list().
Address of the Ferrum bot protection contract invoked via low-level call in the checkBots modifier and in list().
Uniswap pair address computed at construction time by pairForPancake and passed to the bot protection call.
Public mapping of token balances, mutated in transferFrom and list().
Public nested mapping of allowances, mutated in transferFrom and approve.
Total token supply, 1e27, used by list() to compute the owner allocation.
Uniswap V2 router used for addLiquidityETH in list().
WETH address used to derive the pair address.
Base BotProtected constructor storing the bot protection address.
Modifier that performs an external low-level call to the bot protection contract before executing the guarded body.
Token constructor: sets owner = tx.origin, computes the pair, and grants unlimited allowances.
Public payable transfer that delegates to transferFrom with msg.sender as source.
Guarded token transfer: checks bot protection, allowance and balance, then mutates balances.
Sets the allowance for a spender and emits Approval.
Owner-only function that performs a delegatecall to an arbitrary user supplied address.
Pure helper computing the CREATE2 Uniswap pair address from two token addresses.
Owner-only listing function: sets balances, adds liquidity on the router, calls bot protection, then airdrops tokens.
Caller controlled address used for authorization and as the source of transfers.
Transaction origin used as the owner and as an unlimited allowance holder.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used as the Uniswap deadline plus 600 seconds.
Low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary address supplied by the owner.
External low-level call to botProtection inside the checkBots modifier, executed before state updates.
External call to the Uniswap router addLiquidityETH forwarding msg.value before the airdrop loop.
External low-level call to botProtection inside list() used to register the airdrop recipients.
Unchecked arithmetic on balances and supply (Solidity 0.7 has no built-in overflow protection): balanceOf[_from] -= _value, balanceOf[_to] += _value, totalSupply * 6 / 100.

edges.reason: transfer delegates execution to transferFrom passing msg.sender, _to and _value.
transfer uses the untrusted msg.sender as the source of the token movement.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping for source and destination.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance mapping when the caller is not the source.
approve writes the allowance mapping for the untrusted msg.sender.
approve authorizes spending based on the untrusted msg.sender identity.
The ApeHaven constructor assigns the computed pair to uniPair.
The constructor grants unlimited allowances via the allowance mapping.
The constructor uses wrappedEther to derive the Uniswap pair address.
The constructor calls pairForPancake to compute the pair address.
pairForPancake produces the pair value stored in uniPair.
The constructor sets owner and allowances from the untrusted tx.origin.
list overwrites balances in the balanceOf mapping for the contract, owner and airdrop recipients.
list computes the owner allocation from totalSupply.
list uses routerForUniswap to add liquidity.
list is gated by a require comparing msg.sender with the owner state variable.
delegate is gated by a require comparing msg.sender with the owner state variable.
delegate performs its only authorization check against the untrusted msg.sender.
The checkBots modifier targets the botProtection state variable in its low-level call.
The ApeHaven constructor forwards the bot protection address to the base contract.
list derives the router deadline from the miner-influenceable block.timestamp.
delegate forwards the caller supplied target and calldata into the delegatecall.
The checkBots modifier performs the external low-level call on botProtection.
list forwards msg.value and token amounts into the router addLiquidityETH call.
list performs an external low-level call on botProtection with the recipient array.
transferFrom mutates balances with unchecked subtraction and addition on uint balances.
list computes the owner allocation with unchecked multiplication and division of totalSupply.
transferFrom is guarded by the checkBots modifier, which runs before the function body.
The derived ApeHaven constructor invokes the BotProtected base constructor.
transfer passes the untrusted msg.sender as the source address into transferFrom.
The external call inside the checkBots modifier runs before transferFrom updates balances, allowing reentry into transferFrom.
The external router call in list executes before the airdrop loop completes, allowing reentrant state changes.
The external botProtection call in list executes before the loop finalizes, allowing reentry into list or transferFrom.
